app.author: Tim Walter
app.description: Inspired by Space Invaders, the first Arcade Game I played in my youth, and by the great Big Five Games, which made my humble TRS-80 an Arcade Game console and really showed what was possible. I enjoy playing it, hope you do too!
app.name: Space Invaders (Model I Edition)

app.author: Wayne Westmoreland and Terry Gilman
app.description: Armored Patrol is a different version of our first game, a version of the old coin-op game BATTLEZONE. The original was called Tank Zone 2000 (I hate that name!). We submitted it to Scott Adams' company Adventure International whose marketing droids made us change the pyramids to houses, the flying saucer to a robot and the name to Armored Patrol.
app.name: Armored Patrol

app.author: Bill Hogue and Jeff Konyu
app.description: The goal in Attack Force was to drive your little ship between the white squares and blast the bad ramships.  By now our signature "flagship" alien had become a regular character in every game.  The dreaded flagship had an evil rotating eye and also possessed a very deadly laser bolt.  I liked the laser bolt effect so much that I used it on the title page to draw the Attack Force logo.  I still have the original package artwork for Super Nova and Attack Force.
app.name: Attack Force

app.author: Wayne Westmoreland and Terry Gilman
app.description: This time we got permission first. Sega gave us a license for the game ZAXXON and then we wrote this. By this time, Tandy/Radio Shack had started accepting third party programs for sale in their stores and so we struck a deal with them instead of Adventure International. However manufacturing problems on our end limited the distribution. Use the arrow keys to move and SPACE BAR to fire. The game can be stopped by hitting SHIFT+S, and restarted by then hitting ENTER. SHIFT+BREAK aborts the game.
app.name: Zaxxon
